name: YouTube Music Premium

fastest.text: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships, choose YouTube Music Premium and cancel. Joined in the iPhone app? Cancel in your Apple account.

steps: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships in a web browser and sign in with the account that pays.
Next to YouTube Music Premium, select Manage membership.
Choose the option to cancel and confirm.
Check the Status on that page to make sure the membership is ending.
note: Pay through Google Play? Cancel in your Google Play account settings.

faq.a: Your benefits continue until the end of the billing period, and you won't be charged again unless you re-subscribe.

faq.q: I have YouTube Premium. Do I cancel YouTube Music separately?
faq.a: No. YouTube Premium already includes YouTube Music Premium; cancelling YouTube Premium ends both.
Yes. YouTube lets you pause a paid membership instead of cancelling it.
